{{Quote|No, I don't need a hyperspace compass. Buzz off.|Han Solo|<ref name="DE3:TBfC" />}}
A '''hyperspace compass'''<ref name="DE3:TBfC" /> allowed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to navigate by orienting on the [[Galactic Center|center of the galaxy]].<ref name="GttSWU2" /><ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CSWE" /> These devices often served as backups in case of [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] failure,<ref name="JA:TRF90">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]''</ref> and could be used in both [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]].<ref name="GttSWU2" /><ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CSWE" /> In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], [[Unidentified lizard-like alien (Nar Shaddaa)|lizard-like alien]] tried to sell the [[Unidentified hyperspace compass|compass]] to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], speaking in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] [[Language/Legends|language]], to which Han replied that he doesn't need hyperspace compass and told him to "buzz off".<ref name="DE3:TBfC" /> Powerful [[Force-bond/Legends|twin bonds]], like those of [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], could send ionic discharges that reoriented core-relative compasses.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
